name: dompdf/php-svg-lib
input_api: Svg\Document::loadFile(local path), getDimensions parses SVG width and height
scope: Root SVG dimensions; full raster rendering not exercised.
family_note: phenx/php-svg-lib is a Packagist alias for this identical source release and is excluded.

name: meyfa/php-svg
input_api: SVG\SVG::fromFile(local path) returns typed SVG document and rect nodes
scope: One SVG document with two rectangle elements; no rasterization claim.
family_note: jangobrick/php-svg is a Packagist alias for this identical source release and is excluded.

name: enshrined/svg-sanitize
input_api: Sanitizer::sanitize(local SVG byte string) parses SVG/XML and applies SVG element and attribute policy
scope: Valid two-rectangle SVG accepted by SVG sanitizer; parsed output retains rect and fill attributes.
family: enshrined SVG sanitizer over libxml DOM
family_note: Its output is reparsed with PHP DOM only for observing the sanitized SVG tree; the counted input parser is the sanitizer.

name: atelier/svg
input_api: Atelier\Svg\Svg::load(local path) returns typed SVG document; querySelectorAll('rect')
scope: Typed SVG document and two parsed rectangles.
family_note: Uses PHP DOM for XML syntax and its own SVG element objects.

name: mathiasreker/php-svg-optimizer
input_api: SvgOptimizer::withRules(Rule::MinifyColors)->optimizeFile(local path) parses SVG and normalizes fill color
scope: One SVG document with two rectangles; first fill normalized from #ff0000 to red.
family: MathiasReker native PHP SVG optimizer over libxml DOM
family_note: Uses libxml DOM for XML syntax with SVG-specific optimization rules.
